scientific_integrity: An all-parameter analytical proof is supplied and independently executable finite checks test its formulas; priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only the height direction of the Reeve family is classified; direction minimization is not addressed.
Potential prior equivalent formulas in historical semigroup or lattice-polytope literature remain possible.
The finite checker supplements, and does not replace, the proof.
title: Sharp height-gap stabilization for all Reeve simplices
